# Pottery glazes

## Clay bodies

Stoneware fires dense and strong; earthenware stays porous and needs a glaze to hold water. Wedge the clay until a cut face shows no air pockets.

## Cone six glazes

Mid-fire glazes mature around 1220 °C. Dip test tiles first, since a glaze that runs off a vertical tile will glue a pot to the kiln shelf. ^cone-six
